newsitem.title: USA: Sensormatic, Avery Dennison in pact.
newsitem.headline: Sensormatic, Avery Dennison in pact.

text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp said it signed a 20-year licensing agreement with Avery Dennison Corp to make and distribute Sensormatic's Ultra-Max magnetic technology.
Avery Dennison would have access to Sensormatic's technology for these products and would invest in new manufacturing technologies for their production, it said.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Avery Dennison would invest in new manufacturing technologies to produce the Ultra-Max labels in formats designed for high-speed, automatic application, it said.
Sensormatic also said it formed a licensing pact with Wallace Computer Services and a partnership with Paxar Corp. Sensormatic supplies electronic security systems and integrated source tagging.
